client.business_model: Multi-site women's health provider offering OB/GYN, primary care and related telehealth services across several states.
client.sponsor_pe_firm: BlueMountain Capital Management (investment announced Jan-2020); earlier growth financing from Deerfield Management Company
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 in Arlington, Virginia by Sean Glass, Advantia Health has expanded through acquisitions (notably Heartland Women’s Healthcare in 2019) and organic growth to operate dozens of clinics focused on integrated women’s healthcare.

revenue.notes: Publicly available estimates vary widely: Zippia $13.0M (2025), Buzzfile $29.1M, Growjo $22.4M, CanvasBusinessModel $89.0M. No audited or official figure located. Used Growjo midpoint estimate ($22.4M) but treat with high uncertainty.

locations.source: Zoonop article citing 40+ locations across 5 states; cross-checked with AdvantiaHealth.com locations page list
locations.notes: Company website lists 38 individual clinic addresses; press coverage consistently says 'over 40 locations'. Using 40 as rounded figure.

employees.source: LeadIQ (≈501 employees, Dec-2025) and Indeed/SignalHire ranges 500-1,000; FlexJobs description 'approximately 600 team members'
employees.notes: Multiple sources cluster around the 500-700 range; selected 600 as midpoint.
